name: not-found-page
title: Not Found Page
description: A centred error page with huge 404 digits whose lower halves fade out, a two-line explanation and Go Home and Explore buttons. It sits on an empty-state layout with generous negative space.
use: A site 404 should feel calm and on-brand instead of showing a browser error.
avoid: The links point to #, so it navigates nowhere until you wire the buttons to real routes.
a11y: Clear text and real links, but both targets are #, so they do nothing until routes are added. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage with three enormous white-to-grey numerals, their lower halves dissolving into the background, over two centred lines of white text and a pair of pill buttons, one solid light and one dark with an outline.
behaves: Static apart from the buttons: each changes fill under the cursor, with Go Home in the solid style and Explore outlined.
customise: Everything is fixed in the file: the numerals, both lines of copy and the two links, which point to #; changing the text or routes means editing the source.
weight: light: A few lines of text and two buttons; no images or motion.
